text: Where was Dr. Roylott between leaving Baker Street and driving home at dusk?
why: A plain question the story gives reason to ask: Roylott had come to Baker Street, claimed to be going to town, and Miss Stoner said he would be away all day.

text: Where was Dr. Roylott between leaving Baker Street and driving home at dusk? — somewhere near Stoke Moran, waiting until evening

why: A possibility the reader has reason to consider: Roylott was in London in the morning, his whereabouts before dusk are unaccounted for, and Holmes has warned he may be dangerous. The story does not confirm it, but it is a fair question to raise.
